title: Cross-service SLO correlation and root-cause playbook for analytics pipeline
creator: Priya Menon
description: Create a concrete, operational playbook and implementation plan to correlate SLIs/SLOs across ingestion, processing, and console query layers in the analytics pipeline. Aim is to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to repair (MTTR) for tenant-impacting incidents by providing automated correlation signals, enriched traces, and targeted dashboards that point to root cause (batching, KV cache pressure, kernel stalls, downstream DB backpressure).
acceptance_criteria: Definitions: a canonical set of SLIs for ingestion, processing, and console query layers documented and reviewed
Dashboards: a correlation dashboard that surfaces the top 3 probable root causes for any SLO breach within 5 minutes
Tracing: end-to-end request traces with tenant_id and route-level spans for 95% of sampled requests across pipeline
Alerts: automated anomaly alert with linked trace and suggested remediation runbook
Runbook: published playbook with step-by-step RCA for top 5 incident classes and a tested pagerflow integration
technical_design: We will instrument a lightweight cross-service correlation tag (correlation_id) propagated through Kafka message headers and HTTP/X RPC headers. SLIs will be derived at multiple aggregation points and emitted with a common schema to the telemetry topic. A correlation service (stateless) will ingest SLI events and produce candidate correlations using a ruleset + simple Bayesian scoring to prioritize likely root causes. Dashboards will use precomputed correlation scores to surface candidate causes and attach representative traces.
sli_definitions: ingest: ingestion_success_rate = successful_ingest_events / total_ingest_attempts, SLO 99.9% monthly
ingest: ingest_tail_latency_p95 = 95th percentile of time_from_receive_to_store_ms, SLO < 1500ms p95
processing: batch_apply_failure_rate = failed_batch_jobs / total_batch_jobs, SLO 99.5% weekly
console: query_success_rate = successful_console_queries / total_console_queries, SLO 99.0% daily
end-to-end: end_to_end_error_rate = end_to_end_failures / end_to_end_requests, SLO 99.7% monthly
trace_instrumentation: Propagate X-Correlation-ID (uuid4) through HTTP headers and Kafka message header 'X-Correlation-ID'
Tag spans with tenant_id, queue_partition, batch_id, model_variant, kernel_version
Attach KV cache hits/misses as span attributes for generator and embedding services
Record sampling decision and upstream SLI snapshot on entry span to enable reconstruction
logging_convention: All analytics services emit structured JSON logs with fields: timestamp, service, env, tenant_id, correlation_id, request_id, stage, duration_ms, result, error_code
Errors must include 'failure_reason' and 'observability_hint' when available (e.g., 'kafka_leader_unavailable', 'kv_cache_pressure')
Limit high-cardinality freeform fields; use label mappings for known error classes
dashboard_panels: Top-level SLO health summary across ingestion/processing/console (SLO burn, remaining error budget)
Correlation panel: for a selected SLO breach, show candidate root causes with score & contributing signals
Trace sampler preview: sampled traces mapped to timeline with span waterfall and annotated SLI drops
Tenant impact heatmap: tenants by severity and rolling error budget burn rate
Pipeline resource signals: KV cache hit-rate, batch sizes, queue lag, kernel stall metrics
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): instrument 10% of traffic with correlation_id and publish SLI events to telemetry topic. Phase 2: deploy correlation scoring service and surface preliminary correlations in 'Observability Labs' dashboard for internal SRE/eng. Phase 3: enable automated alerting and attach runbook links. Phase 4: full rollout across all tenants with opt-out for high-security private deployments.
